    "uid_group",
    "primary_group",
    "groups",
    "uid_model",
    "model",
    "uid_fuel",
    "fuel",
    "uid_voltage",
    "voltage",
    "uid_technical_package",
    "technical_package",
    "vehicle",
    "linked_devices",
    "device_slots",
    "uid_image_logo",
    "created_at",
    "updated_at"
  ],
  "default_columns": [
    "identification",
    "organization_name",
    "entity_name",
    "unit_name",
    "effective_lifecycle",
    "created_at"
  ],
  "filters": [
    {"field": "uid", "operators": ["eq", "in"]},
    {"field": "uid_organization", "operators": ["eq"]},
    {"field": "uid_entity", "operators": ["eq", "in"]},
    {"field": "uid_unit", "operators": ["eq", "in"]},
    {
      "field": "identification",
      "operators": ["eq", "prefix", "contains"],
      "search_operator": "contains"
    },
    {"field": "created_at", "operators": ["gte", "lt"]},
    {"field": "updated_at", "operators": ["gte", "lt"]}
  ],
  "sorts": [
    "identification",
    "created_at",
    "updated_at",
    "uid"
  ],
  "default_sort": [
    {"field": "identification", "direction": "asc"},
    {"field": "uid", "direction": "asc"}
  ],
  "formats": [
    {"code": "xlsx", "visibility": ["private"]}
  ],
  "limits": {
    "max_rows": 500000,
    "max_bytes": 104857600,
    "max_ttl_seconds": 2592000,
    "page_default": 50,
    "page_max": 100
  },
  "json_schemas": [
    {
      "source_code": "assets.inventory.v2",
      "base_field": "groups",
      "postgres_type": "jsonb",
      "nodes": [
        {
          "path": "groups[*].name",
          "type": "text",
          "multiplicity": "many"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "json_paths": [
    {
      "selector": "groups[*].name",
      "label": "Nome do grupo",
      "default": false
    }
  ]
}
